overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the composite superintendent evaluation used at the open meeting was a public record, but the individual member evaluations were not used at the meeting, so the OML did not require their disclosure.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the committee failed to provide copies of all written superintendent evaluations submitted by individual members to the chair for the annual evaluation.
allegations.key_passage: Here, because the individual evaluations were not used during an open meeting, the Open Meeting Law does not require their disclosure.
